intro: Diabetes is one of the most common conditions you will meet, and your everyday care and quick action keep people well.
points: You are not authorised to administer insulin or diabetes medication without specific training, assessed competence and proper delegation.
A severe hypo — unconscious, fitting or unable to swallow safely — is a 999 emergency; put nothing in their mouth.
Treat a hypo below 4 mmol/L with fast-acting sugar, wait 10 to 15 minutes, then a longer-acting carbohydrate.
Watch for hypo signs such as shaky, sweaty, pale, confused or irritable, and treat any suspected hypo promptly.
Report DKA warning signs — vomiting, tummy pain, deep breathing, fruity breath, drowsiness — as a life-threatening 999 emergency.
Check feet daily, report cuts or redness early, and never cut corns yourself — that is a podiatrist's job.
